stem.text: Different substances, such as sucrose and amino acids, can move in different directions in the phloem sieve tube elements.

A.text: Active transport occurs in some phloem sieve tube elements and mass flow occurs in other sieve tube elements.

B.text: Both active transport and mass flow occur in each individual phloem sieve tube element.

C.text: Mass flow occurs in both directions at the same time in each individual phloem sieve tube element.

D.text: Mass flow occurs in different directions in different phloem sieve tube elements at the same time.
